About Our School

A Legacy of Learning in Maharajganj

Founded in 1998, R.S. Public School has grown into one of the most trusted educational institutions in Maharajganj district. Affiliated with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), our school blends academic rigour with character development to produce well-rounded individuals.

Our sprawling campus, modern laboratories, trained faculty, and vibrant extra-curricular culture create an environment where every child can discover their potential and pursue it with confidence.

Leadership

Principal's Message

Mr. Chhatrapal Chaurasiya
Post Graduation (Education)
Principal
"Education is not just about filling a pail, but lighting a fire. At R.S. Public School, we believe every child carries within them an extraordinary potential — our mission is simply to help them discover it."

Dear Parents, Students and Well-wishers,


It is my privilege to lead this institution that has, for over two decades, stood as a pillar of quality education in Maharajganj. Our school is not merely a place of instruction — it is a community of learners, where curiosity is encouraged, values are instilled, and dreams are given wings.


We follow the CBSE curriculum with a firm belief that excellence is achieved not through rote learning, but through understanding, application, and the freedom to think independently. Our faculty members are passionate mentors who go beyond textbooks to prepare students for the challenges and opportunities of the 21st century.


I warmly invite you to be a part of our journey — together, we will shape a generation of responsible, confident, and compassionate citizens.

— Mr. Chhatrapal Chaurasiya
Leadership

Vice Principal's Message

Ms. Swetha Miliya
Post Graduation
Vice Principal
"Education empowers students to become confident, responsible, and compassionate individuals who contribute positively to society."

Dear Parents, Students and Well-wishers,


It gives me immense pleasure to be a part of R.S. Public School, where we are committed to nurturing young minds through quality education, discipline, and strong moral values.


Our aim is to create a learning environment that encourages curiosity, creativity, and critical thinking while helping students achieve academic excellence.


Together with our dedicated teachers and supportive parents, we strive to prepare students for a bright and successful future.

— Ms. Swetha Miliya
Campus Life

World-Class Facilities

Every facility at R.S. Public School is designed to inspire learning, encourage exploration, and support every dimension of student growth.

Smart Classrooms
Interactive boards, projectors and digital learning tools in every classroom for engaging, tech-enabled lessons.
Science Laboratories
Fully equipped Physics, Chemistry and Biology labs enabling hands-on experiments and scientific inquiry.
Digital Library
A rich collection of 10,000+ books, e-resources and periodicals to nurture a lifelong love of reading.
Sports & Athletics
Spacious ground for cricket, football and athletics. Basketball, volleyball and badminton courts available.
Computer Lab
High-speed internet enabled computer lab with 60 systems for coding, digital literacy and online research.
Music & Arts
Dedicated rooms for classical music, dance, drawing and fine arts to nurture creativity and expression.
School Transport
GPS-tracked bus fleet covering Maharajganj and surrounding areas for safe, comfortable daily commute.
Hygienic Canteen
Clean, nutritious meals and snacks prepared under strict hygiene standards to keep students energised.
